cpmplus.model.need.sel: Select a part (cube or group) first.
cpmplus.model.need.cubes: Select one or more cubes first.
cpmplus.model.need.two: Select two or more parts first.
cpmplus.model.panel.hint: Modelling tools. Hover a button to see what it does.
cpmplus.model.panel.gap: Gap between the two: %1 / %2 / %3 px (centres %4 px apart)
cpmplus.model.panel.show.desc: Opens the panel with every modelling tool (Edit mode).
cpmplus.model.shapes.desc: Sphere, cylinder, cone, ring, arch, capsule and other shapes made of cubes, with a preview. In CPM they are colour cubes (no skin space used).
cpmplus.model.shapes.tip: Pick the shape and the size; the preview shows on the model. It goes into a new group, in the middle of the selection.
cpmplus.model.shapes.tip.cpm: Pick the shape and the size; the preview shows on the model. It goes into a new group, in the middle of the selection, made of colour cubes (no skin space used; recolour them later with 'Recolour').
cpmplus.model.shapes.f.name: Name
cpmplus.model.shapes.empty: That shape came out empty: make it bigger or the thickness smaller.
cpmplus.model.repeat.desc: Makes copies of the selected part in a line, a circle or a spiral, with a preview: teeth, spikes, petals, chains, fences.
cpmplus.model.repeat.tip: The copies show in the preview. In a circle the part turns around the chosen axis (the pivot of the parent group by default).
cpmplus.model.repeat.f.turn: The copies turn too (they face the centre)
cpmplus.model.repeat.f.wrap: Put everything in a new group
cpmplus.model.align.desc: Lines the selected parts up (by a side or by the middle), spreads them with equal gaps or makes one touch another. Works with rotated parts.
cpmplus.model.align.tip: Pick what to do; the preview shows where each part ends up.
cpmplus.model.align.gap.equal: Equal (the first and the last stay put)
cpmplus.model.measure.desc: Ruler: click a point, then another; shows the distance in pixels (and in blocks). The point snaps to the nearest cube corner. Esc clears the measurements.
cpmplus.model.measure.hint: Measure: click the first point, then the second. Esc clears.
cpmplus.model.copy.desc: Copies size, rotation, pivot, texture (UV), colour and other settings from one part to the other selected parts at once.
cpmplus.model.copy.tip: Pick which part to copy from and tick what to copy; the other selected parts get it.
cpmplus.model.copy.a.pivot: Pivot (at the same point of the part)
cpmplus.model.cycle: Click again selects the part behind
cpmplus.model.cycle.desc: Click again on the same spot (no Shift/Ctrl) to select the part behind; clicking more goes through all of them.
cpmplus.model.hover: Name of the part under the mouse
cpmplus.model.hover.desc: Shows the name of the part under the mouse (with its groups) next to the cursor, in Edit mode.
cpmplus.model.similar.desc: Selects parts like the selected ones: same size, same colour, same group, the twin on the other side or the same name without the number.
cpmplus.model.similar.twin: The twin on the other side (mirrored)
cpmplus.model.similar.name: Same name (without the number)
cpmplus.model.rename.desc: Renames many parts at once: name + number, before/after, replace text, swap left ↔ right or clean accents and spaces. Shows before → after.
cpmplus.model.rename.tip: The list below shows how each name will end up.
cpmplus.model.rename.f.deep: Also what is inside the groups
cpmplus.model.duptex.desc: Duplicates the part and gives the copy a free piece of the texture of its own, with the same painting. Painting the copy never changes the original.
cpmplus.model.duptex.noroom: There is no free space on the texture for the copy. Free some space (Texture map shows where it is free), make the texture bigger or use colour cubes.
cpmplus.model.duptex.done: Copy with its own texture: %1 cubes
cpmplus.model.texmap.desc: Shows how much of the texture is free (green), used (grey) and used by more than one part (red). Counts the normal player, the 2nd layer and everything already painted.
cpmplus.model.texmap.tip: Green = free · grey = used · red = the same area used by more than one part (normal for mirrored arms).
cpmplus.model.lib.desc: Ready-made parts (ears, 12 horns, halo, crown, top hat, witch hat and 6 animated tails) and the parts you saved. Each part goes onto the right body part by itself.
cpmplus.model.lib.tip: Click a part to see it on the model, then Put on (or double-click it). Ctrl+Z takes the part away.
cpmplus.model.lib.noroom: There is no free space on the texture for this part's painting. Free some space (Texture map shows where), make the texture bigger or use colour cubes.
cpmplus.model.lib.empty: You have not saved any parts yet. Select cubes or groups on the model and click "Save the selection" below (or right-click the part > Save to library).
cpmplus.model.lib.save.desc: Keeps the selected part (cubes, groups, colours, glow and painting) to put on any model later.
cpmplus.model.lib.save.tip: The part is kept in this Blockbench. To take it to another computer or send it to someone, use Export in the library.
cpmplus.model.lib.save.painted: %1 painted cubes: their painting goes along.
cpmplus.model.lib.save.empty: Nothing to save: select the parts you made (the player's head and body come with every model).
cpmplus.model.lib.f.name: Name
cpmplus.model.lib.del.ask: Delete "%1" from the library? Models you already put this part on do not change.
cpmplus.model.lib.export.none: You have no parts of your own to export yet.
cpmplus.model.lib.badfile: This file is not a CPM+ parts library.
cpmplus.model.lib.dberr: Could not use the saved library in this Blockbench: %1
cpmplus.model.lib.cat.head: Head
cpmplus.model.lib.root.head: Head
cpmplus.model.lib.save.painted.one: 1 painted cube: its painting goes along.
cpmplus.model.lib.noroom.ask: There is no free space on the texture for this part's painting. "More texture space" doubles the texture's area (%1 → %2; the image becomes %3 pixels) without moving anything already painted: the part goes on fully painted. "Use colours only" gives each cube its main colour and uses no texture.
cpmplus.model.lib.bb.tip: Tick the groups to bring (everything inside them comes along, with the painting and the animations). The part is saved in My parts.
cpmplus.model.lib.bb.auto: Work it out from the file
cpmplus.model.lib.bb.bad: This file is not a Blockbench model (.bbmodel).
cpmplus.model.lib.bb.nogroups: This file has no groups to bring.
cpmplus.model.lib.bb.meshes: %1 meshes were left out: CPM only uses cubes. To bring meshes in, use Modelling > Convert 3D model into parts.
cpmplus.model.lib.bb.molang: %1 animation keys with a formula (Molang) were left out.
cpmplus.model.weight.tip: Information only: above ~256 parts CPM draws the model a bit slower when many players are near (a crowded server). For animations, videos and pictures it does not matter.
cpmplus.model.merge.desc: Joins matching colour cubes that touch (same colour, turn, inflate and glow, in the same group) into as few cubes as possible. The model looks exactly the same with fewer parts.
cpmplus.model.merge.tip: The model keeps the same look: only how many cubes it uses changes. Groups are never mixed (animations stay the same). Ctrl+Z undoes it.
cpmplus.model.merge.none: Nothing to join here: no matching colour cubes touch.
cpmplus.model.merge.stay.painted: %1 painted cubes stay as they are (joining would change their painting).
cpmplus.model.merge.stay.overlap: %1 cubes stay as they are: different colours in the same place.
cpmplus.model.merge.stay.grid: %1 cubes stay as they are: sizes off the 1/16 grid.
cpmplus.model.merge.stay.flat: %1 planes (no thickness) stay as they are.
cpmplus.model.lib.f.hd.desc: This part has a high resolution painting (fine detail). In HD every skin pixel gets 8×8 pixels: the skin looks the same and the painting stays sharp. Without HD the painting is reduced to pixel art.
cpmplus.model.lib.f.tone.desc: The part is painted in the skin colour of your skin (read on the cheeks and the sides of the head), keeping the drawing's shadows and lights. Untick it to keep the part's own colour.
cpmplus.model.hd.desc: Raises the texture's resolution without changing the UV: every pixel becomes 2×2, 4×4, 8×8... The skin looks exactly the same and gets room for detail (HD feathers, HD brushes).
cpmplus.model.hd.tip: The texture has %1×%2 pixels for a %3×%4 UV. Choose how many pixels every UV pixel gets. The skin looks exactly the same; it only gets resolution for detail.
cpmplus.model.hd.already: The texture already has the highest resolution (%1×).
cpmplus.model.slice.desc: Cuts the cube into pieces (at a point or into equal parts). Every piece keeps the same painting it had.
cpmplus.model.slice.tip: Pick the axis and where to cut. The painting follows each piece and the cut shows the end of the cube. Ctrl+Z undoes it.
cpmplus.model.slice.f.at: Where to cut (pixels from the start)
cpmplus.model.slice.none: Nothing to cut with these sizes.
cpmplus.model.slice.snapped: The cut moved to the nearest pixel line so the painting stays straight.
cpmplus.model.slice.why.base: Left as they are (the player's base): %1
cpmplus.model.slice.why.outside: The cut is outside these cubes: %1
cpmplus.model.slice.why.thin: Piece too thin for the cube's inflate: %1
cpmplus.model.slice.why.few: Too many parts for the size (the painting only cuts on whole pixels): %1
cpmplus.model.slice.why.nohole: The hole has no size in: %1
cpmplus.model.slice.why.all: The hole is as big as the whole cube: %1
cpmplus.model.hole.desc: Opens a rectangular hole through the cube. The rest of the cube becomes up to 4 parts with the same painting.
cpmplus.model.hole.tip: The hole goes through the cube along the chosen axis. Set the size of the hole and where it starts (pixels from the edge). The walls of the hole use the painting of the cube's sides. Ctrl+Z undoes it.
cpmplus.model.hole.f.at.x: Hole starts at X (from the edge)
cpmplus.model.hole.f.at.y: Hole starts at Y (from the edge)
cpmplus.model.hole.f.at.z: Hole starts at Z (from the edge)
cpmplus.model.hole.sum: %1 cube(s) with a hole: they become %2 parts
cpmplus.model.check.desc: Looks for common modelling problems (flickering faces, hairline gaps, mixed paintings, empty groups, repeated or hidden cubes) and fixes them with one click.
cpmplus.model.check.tip: Each row is one problem. 'Show' selects the parts; 'Fix' makes one small change (Ctrl+Z undoes each one). The export warnings still show up when you export.
cpmplus.model.check.none: Nothing found: the model is in order.
cpmplus.model.check.fixedall: %1 problem(s) fixed. Ctrl+Z undoes them all at once.
cpmplus.model.check.noroom: Could not fix it: there is no free space on the texture.
cpmplus.model.check.kind.zfight: Faces in the same place (they flicker in game)
cpmplus.model.check.kind.gap: Hairline gap between parts (a line shows)
cpmplus.model.check.kind.uv: Mixed paintings (both parts use the same piece of the texture)
cpmplus.model.check.kind.zero: Cube without size (it does not show)
cpmplus.model.check.kind.dup: The same cube twice in the same place
cpmplus.model.check.uv: %1 and %2: painting one changes the other
cpmplus.model.check.fix.zfight: Moves %1 out a hair (inflate +0.02) so it is on top
cpmplus.model.check.fix.uv: Gives %1 a free piece of the texture with the same painting
cpmplus.model.layer2.desc: Makes a slightly bigger shell around each cube, like the hat and jacket of a Minecraft skin, with its own free piece of the texture.
cpmplus.model.layer2.tip: Each cube gets a slightly bigger 2nd layer, right below it in the list. The layer gets its own free piece of the texture: it can start with the cube's painting or be transparent to paint later (hair, hood, details). Ctrl+Z undoes it.
cpmplus.model.layer2.f.inflate: How much bigger than the cube (inflate)
cpmplus.model.layer2.none: None of the selected cubes can get a 2nd layer.
cpmplus.model.layer2.name: %1_layer2
cpmplus.model.layer2.noroom: There is no free space on the texture for the 2nd layer. Free some space (the texture map shows where) or make the texture HD.
cpmplus.model.layer2.notex: The project has no texture for the 2nd layer.
cpmplus.model.layer2.why.base: Left out (player parts: use CPM's 'Add 2nd layer'): %1
cpmplus.model.layer2.why.shell: Left out (they are a 2nd layer already): %1
cpmplus.model.layer2.why.has: Left out (they have a 2nd layer already): %1
cpmplus.model.bases.desc: Puts a ready-made body on the model: taur (horse body with 4 legs), naga (snake tail), digitigrade legs, tall or short legs. Every bone has its own group, ready to animate.
cpmplus.model.bases.tip: Pick a base. It goes on the right body parts with its bones ready to animate, and the normal legs are switched off. Ctrl+Z undoes it all.
cpmplus.model.bases.have: The model already has: %1. Adding another base puts both together.
cpmplus.model.bases.cpm: The ready-made bases are for CPM projects.
cpmplus.model.bases.noroot: Body parts missing in the project: %1
cpmplus.model.bases.notex: The project has no skin texture.
cpmplus.model.bases.d.taur: Horse body with 4 legs. The front legs walk with your legs; the back legs copy the leg on the other side (a trot).
cpmplus.model.bases.d.naga: A snake tail instead of legs: 11 segments in a chain, thinner and thinner, a lighter belly.
cpmplus.model.bases.d.digi: Animal legs with the extra backward joint: thigh, shin, ankle and foot.
cpmplus.model.bases.d.tall: 16 px legs with a knee, painted with the skin's legs; head, body and arms go up 4 px.
cpmplus.model.bases.d.short: 8 px legs with a knee, painted with the skin's legs; head, body and arms go down 4 px.
cpmplus.model.link.desc: Copies the group and keeps the copy linked to the original: everything you change inside the original (cubes, sizes, turns, colours, painting) changes in the copy too. The copy's own group keeps its place and turn. 'Unlink copy' sets it free.
cpmplus.model.link.name: %1_linked
cpmplus.model.link.done: Linked copy made: move it wherever you want. Change the original and the copy follows.
cpmplus.model.link.need: Select a group (not a body part) first.
cpmplus.model.unlink.desc: Sets the linked copy free from the original: from now on it is a normal part you change on its own.
cpmplus.model.unlink.done: Copy unlinked: it is a normal part now.
cpmplus.model.build.desc: Click a face to put a 1 px block against it. Drag a face to pull it out or push it in (the cube grows or shrinks). Shift + drag: a new block as deep as you pull.
cpmplus.model.build.hint: Build: click a face = 1 px block · drag a face = pull / push · Shift + drag = new block · Ctrl = quarter pixels · Esc cancels
cpmplus.model.build.name: %1_block
cpmplus.model.text.desc: Writes a text made of cubes (pixel letters with accents), in a new group on the body part you choose. The preview shows while you type.
cpmplus.model.text.tip: Type the text and choose the font, the size and where it goes; the preview shows on the model. The letter pixels become a few cubes, in a new group.
cpmplus.model.text.tip.cpm: Type the text and choose the font, the size and where it goes; the preview shows on the model. The letter pixels become a few colour cubes (they use no skin space), in a new group.
cpmplus.model.text.where.none: Loose, in the middle of the world
cpmplus.model.text.f.name: Group name
cpmplus.model.text.missing: no drawing in this font for: %1
cpmplus.model.vox.desc: Opens a MagicaVoxel model (.vox) and turns it into colour cubes: each colour becomes a few cubes, in a new group on the body part you choose.
cpmplus.model.vox.tip: Each colour becomes as few colour cubes as possible (they use no skin space). MagicaVoxel's front faces the player's front. The preview shows on the model.
cpmplus.model.vox.info.palette: No palette in the file: using MagicaVoxel's default colours.
cpmplus.model.vox.info.skipped: %1 voxels outside their model were ignored.
cpmplus.model.vox.where.none: Loose, standing in the middle of the world
cpmplus.model.vox.toomany: %1 cubes is too many for Blockbench (maximum %2). Pick a single model or simplify the .vox.
cpmplus.model.vox.cpmonly: Import .vox works in CPM projects: the colours become CPM colour cubes.
cpmplus.model.vox.bad: This .vox file could not be read:
cpmplus.model.vox.bad.magic: it is not a MagicaVoxel file (.vox).
cpmplus.model.vox.bad.nomain: the file has no main part (MAIN).
cpmplus.model.vox.bad.trunc: the file is cut short or damaged.
cpmplus.model.vox.bad.chunk: a part of the file is damaged.
cpmplus.model.vox.bad.size: a model has an invalid size (maximum 256 × 256 × 256).
cpmplus.model.vox.bad.big: the file is too big (maximum 16 MB and 2 million voxels).
cpmplus.model.vox.bad.empty: there are no voxels in the file.
cpmplus.model.vox.bad.cells: the scene is too big to become cubes (pick a single model).
cpmplus.model.joint.desc: Swings the selected group around its pivot for a few seconds (X, Y and Z), only on screen, to see if the pivot is in the right place and if the joint opens a gap (red where it opens). Nothing in the model changes. Click again to stop.
cpmplus.model.joint.running: Testing the joint of '%1': turning on %2. Red shows where a gap opens; the yellow ball is the pivot.
cpmplus.model.joint.alone: '%1' does not touch any other part: there is no joint to check.
cpmplus.model.joint.ok: Joint of '%1': the pivot is in the right place (the middle of the joint stays attached). Turning %3°, the corners open up to %2 px (normal for cube joints; a part on top hides it).
cpmplus.model.joint.loose: Joint of '%1': the pivot looks out of place. Turning %3°, the middle of the joint comes loose by up to %2 px.
cpmplus.model.restpose.desc: In Animate mode: the pose the animation shows at the playhead becomes the bones' rest pose (group rotation and position). The keys of every animation of those bones are adjusted, so the animations stay the same.
cpmplus.model.restpose.tip: The pose of the chosen animation, at the chosen time, becomes the model's rest. Animations that move these bones are adjusted and stay the same; in the ones that do not move them, they show the new pose. Ctrl+Z undoes everything.
cpmplus.model.restpose.noanim: This model has no animations. Make an animation with the pose you want and use this in Animate mode.
cpmplus.model.restpose.b.all: All that are out of their rest
cpmplus.model.restpose.f.follow: Additive ones follow the new pose
cpmplus.model.restpose.none: At this time the bones are at rest: nothing to apply.
cpmplus.model.restpose.done: Pose applied as rest: %1 bones, %2 animations adjusted
cpmplus.model.restpose.f.follow.desc: Checked: the other additive animations are not adjusted and move from the new pose. Unchecked (normal): every animation stays the same.
cpmplus.model.flatten.desc: Thin little cubes lying on the face of a bigger painted cube (eyes, buttons, stickers, thin plates) become painting on that face and are deleted: the model looks the same from the front, with fewer cubes.
cpmplus.model.flatten.tip: Each thin detail on a painted face becomes pixels of that face (colour cubes with their colour, painted cubes with their front painting; transparent pixels let the face show). Green = becomes painting, orange = stays as it is. Ctrl+Z undoes everything, pixels included.
cpmplus.model.flatten.f.all: Every thin detail of the model
cpmplus.model.flatten.none: No thin detail lying on a painted face here.
cpmplus.model.flatten.stay.notflat: %1 stay: they do not lie on a painted face.
cpmplus.model.flatten.stay.colourbase: %1 stay: the part below is a colour cube (no painting to take the detail).
cpmplus.model.flatten.stay.overhang: %1 stay: they go past the edge of the face.
cpmplus.model.flatten.stay.shared: %1 stay: that face's painting is used by another part too (it would change on both).
cpmplus.model.flatten.stay.turned: %1 stay: they are turned (or inside a turned group).
cpmplus.model.flatten.stay.glow: %1 stay: they glow (the glow would be lost).
cpmplus.model.flatten.stay.tinted: %1 stay: they have a colour over the painting (Recolour).
cpmplus.model.flatten.stay.texture: %1 stay: they are on another texture (do one at a time).
cpmplus.model.flatten.stay.thick: %1 stay: they are thicker than the chosen maximum.
cpmplus.model.flatten.stay.base: %1 are the player's own body parts.
cpmplus.model.symmetry.desc: Compares the left parts with the right ones (by names with left/right, esquerdo/direito, _l/_r, or by the mirrored place) and shows what is not the same, with a button to mirror one side onto the other.
cpmplus.model.symmetry.tip: Each row is a pair of parts (left ↔ right) that are not mirrored. 'Mirror from this side' makes the other side the mirror of this one. Click the name to select the pair. Each fix has its own Ctrl+Z.
cpmplus.model.sym.ok: All symmetric: every part has its mirrored pair.
cpmplus.model.sym.missing: '%1' has no pair on the other side (expected: '%2').
cpmplus.model.sym.k.kind: one is a group, the other a cube
cpmplus.model.sym.fix.tip: Makes the other side the same as '%1', mirrored.
cpmplus.model.fpview.desc: Shows the model the way you see it in first person in the game: the camera goes to the player's eyes, looking forward (Minecraft's field of view 70), and the arm shows where Minecraft draws the hand. Click again (or Esc) to get the previous camera back.
cpmplus.model.fpview.noarm: This model has no right arm (right_arm): the first person cannot be shown.
cpmplus.model.convert.desc: Turns a rigged 3D model (from another Blockbench tab or a .bbmodel / .glb file) into CPM parts: HD painted planes that follow the bones, on the body part you choose, with the model's animations.
cpmplus.model.convert.tip: Each bone becomes a group and the mesh becomes painted planes that move with it. Open the 3D model in another tab (File > Open) or choose a .bbmodel or .glb (glTF) file. An FBX: export it as .glb from Blender.
cpmplus.model.convert.cpmonly: Convert 3D model works in a CPM project: open your CPM model and the 3D model in another tab (or choose the .bbmodel file).
cpmplus.model.convert.bad: This file is not a 3D model that can be read (.bbmodel, .glb or .gltf).
cpmplus.model.convert.nomesh: This model has no meshes to convert. Cubes can come in through the Parts library.
cpmplus.model.convert.moved: You switched projects during the conversion: nothing was added.
cpmplus.model.convert.count: Makes %1 painted planes in %2 groups · texture: ~%3 px² (%4)
cpmplus.model.convert.room.no: does not fit even on a 512 texture: make it smaller or use Normal texture
cpmplus.model.convert.molang: %1 keys with formulas (molang) were left out.
cpmplus.model.convert.manyanims: Only the first %1 animations are listed here.
cpmplus.model.convert.meshes.sel: Only the ones selected in the tab (%1)
cpmplus.model.convert.f.mirror: Right and left side share one painting (uses less texture)
cpmplus.model.convert.f.loop: Blend the animation's end into its start (no jump)
cpmplus.model.m2c.desc: Turns the meshes of a 3D model (from another Blockbench tab or a .bbmodel / .glb file) into CPM cubes: cuts it into little cubes of the size you choose, takes the colours from the texture and joins everything into as few cubes as possible.
cpmplus.model.m2c.tip: The mesh becomes little cubes with the texture's colours, joined into a few cubes. Open the 3D model in another tab (File > Open) or choose a .bbmodel or .glb file.
cpmplus.model.m2c.cpmonly: Mesh to cubes works in a CPM project: open your CPM model and the 3D model in another tab (or choose the .bbmodel file).
cpmplus.model.m2c.mode.paint: Painted cubes (exact colours, use the texture)
cpmplus.model.m2c.toobig: Too big to cut: make the little cubes bigger or the model smaller.
cpmplus.model.m2c.many: More than %1 cubes: make the little cubes bigger or the model smaller.
cpmplus.model.gltf.external: This .gltf uses separate files (.bin or pictures): export it as .glb (a single file) and try again.
cpmplus.model.outline.desc: Makes a cartoon outline around the selected parts: thin dark lines on the edges of their shape. It looks the same in the game, from every side, and uses no skin space.
cpmplus.model.outline.tip: The lines sit on the edges of the shape (cubes that touch become one shape). They go into an 'outline' group inside the parts' group, so they follow the animations. The eye in the Outliner shows or hides the outline. Ctrl+Z undoes it.
cpmplus.model.outline.f.replace: Replace the outline that is already there
cpmplus.model.outline.f.concave: Lines in the inner corners too
cpmplus.model.outline.f.concave.desc: Also puts a line where the shape folds inwards (the corner of an L). Off, only the outer edges get a line, like a cartoon outline.
cpmplus.model.outline.f.each: Each cube with its own outline
cpmplus.model.outline.f.each.desc: Outlines every cube on its own, even the ones that touch (lines show where they meet).
cpmplus.model.outline.replaces: The outline that is already in %1 will be replaced by the new one.
cpmplus.model.outline.split: A shape is too complex to be seen as one part: each of its cubes got its own outline.
cpmplus.model.stitch.desc: CPM uses one texture (the skin). Merges every other texture of the project into the skin: each used piece is copied pixel for pixel into free space and the cubes use the skin. The model looks the same.
cpmplus.model.stitch.tip: Each painted piece of the other textures goes to a free spot of the skin, with the same pixels, and the cubes use the skin. The model keeps the same look. Ctrl+Z undoes everything.
cpmplus.model.stitch.sum: %1 textures become one (the skin): %2 pieces of %3 cubes go to free spots of the skin
cpmplus.model.stitch.onlyunused: No cube uses the other textures: they will just be removed.
cpmplus.model.stitch.hd: A texture has more detail than the skin: each skin pixel becomes %1×%1 equal pixels (the model does not change and no pixel is lost).
cpmplus.model.stitch.keep: Stay apart (they are CPM textures: cape, elytra or armor): %1
cpmplus.model.stitch.why.odd: Stay as they are (their size does not give whole pixels): %1
cpmplus.model.stitch.why.noskin: Could not find the skin texture.
cpmplus.model.stitch.why.one: The project already has one texture.
cpmplus.model.stitch.why.skinodd: The skin has a size that does not give whole pixels.
cpmplus.model.stitch.why.density: These textures cannot be merged without losing pixels.
cpmplus.model.stitch.nofit: It does not fit even with the skin at %1×%2 pixels.
cpmplus.model.stitch.f.grow.desc: There is not enough free space on the skin. Its area grows and everything already there stays in place (top left corner).
cpmplus.model.stitch.nogrow: It does not fit without a bigger skin: nothing changed.
cpmplus.model.stitch.pic: How the skin will look (the new pieces framed in yellow):
cpmplus.model.stitch.result: After: a skin with a %1×%2 area (%3×%4 pixels).
cpmplus.model.cut.desc: Uses a cube as a cutter: its space is taken out of the other selected cubes (a hole, a slot, a corner). The pieces left keep the same painting.
cpmplus.model.cut.tip: The cutter is the cube selected last (you can change it below). Its space leaves the other selected cubes; what is left becomes pieces with the same painting, and the walls of the cut use the paint of the cube's sides. Ctrl+Z undoes it.
cpmplus.model.cut.need: Select the cubes to cut and, last, the cube that cuts.
cpmplus.model.cut.all: Go away (the cutter covers them whole): %1
cpmplus.model.cut.none: Nothing to cut: the cutter does not touch the other cubes.
cpmplus.model.cut.snapped: The cut moved to the nearest pixel line, so the painting stays straight.
cpmplus.model.cut.why.turned: Stay as they are: they are turned differently from the cutter (the cut would be slanted). Turn the cutter like them, or by 90 degrees: %1
cpmplus.model.cut.why.miss: The cutter does not touch these cubes: %1
cpmplus.model.cut.why.thin: A piece would be too thin for the cube's inflate: %1
cpmplus.model.hoverbox: Highlight the cube under the mouse
cpmplus.model.hoverbox.desc: Shows a yellow outline on the cube under the mouse (in Edit mode), so you know which part you will click. It stays on or off after closing Blockbench.
cpmplus.model.stitch.nothing: Nothing to merge: the other textures stay as they are (see below why).
cpmplus.model.uvpack.desc: Lays the painted areas of the selected parts (or of the whole model, when nothing is selected) out again on the skin: close together, no overlaps, the same pixels. Areas shared on purpose (mirrored twins, repeated parts) stay shared and the player's skin never moves.
cpmplus.model.uvpack.tip: Each painted area goes to a spot closer to the others, with the same pixels, and the cubes use the new spot: the model looks the same. The player's skin (head, body, arms, legs and 2nd layer) stays where it is. Ctrl+Z undoes everything.
cpmplus.model.uvpack.tidy: The texture is already tidy: nothing to change.
cpmplus.model.uvpack.nofit.big: It does not fit on the texture.
cpmplus.model.uvpack.freed.off: The old areas stay painted (not cleared).
cpmplus.model.uvpack.keepmode: There is not enough room to pack everything on this texture: only the mixed paintings get a spot of their own, the rest stays where it is.
cpmplus.model.uvpack.grown: The texture grows: %1×%2 → %3×%4 (everything already there stays in the top left corner).
cpmplus.model.uvpack.kept.vanilla: Stay in place (they use the player's skin): %1
cpmplus.model.uvpack.kept.out: Stay in place (shared with parts that are not selected): %1
cpmplus.model.uvpack.kept.other: Stay in place (they use another texture): %1
cpmplus.model.uvpack.otherfaces: Faces on other textures (they do not move; use 'Merge textures' first): %1
cpmplus.model.uvpack.unfixable: Mixed paintings that cannot be separated (they are in areas that stay): %1
cpmplus.model.uvpack.nofit: It does not fit, not even with more texture space.
cpmplus.model.uvpack.nogrow: It does not fit on the current texture: tick 'More texture space'.
cpmplus.model.uvpack.f.clear.desc: The pixels nobody uses any more become free space for new parts.
cpmplus.model.uvpack.f.fix.desc: Two different paintings that use the same pixels by mistake (the 'Mixed paintings' of Check model): each part gets its own copy, so painting one no longer changes the other.
cpmplus.model.uvpack.f.grow.desc: The texture's area grows and everything already there stays in the same place (top left corner).
cpmplus.model.uvpack.none: None of the chosen parts has a painted area that can move on the skin.
cpmplus.model.uvpack.why.noskin: Could not find the skin texture.
cpmplus.model.uvpack.why.anim: The skin is an animated texture (frames): it cannot be packed.
cpmplus.model.uvpack.why.odd: The skin has a size that does not give whole pixels.
cpmplus.model.magnet.desc: Turns the magnet on or off: when you move (or resize) cubes and groups with Blockbench's arrows, the face lands exactly on the face, edge or middle of the cube next to it once it gets close (0.5 px). A pink guide shows where it snapped. The small arrow next to it opens the options.
cpmplus.model.magnet.opts.desc: The magnet's distance and whether it also works when resizing.
cpmplus.model.magnet.f.dist.desc: How close (in model pixels) a face has to get to snap. With Shift or Ctrl (finer steps) the magnet gets weaker in the same proportion.
cpmplus.model.magnet.f.resize.desc: The face you drag with the Resize tool also snaps to its neighbours.
cpmplus.model.combine.desc: Brings parts of another model into this one (from another Blockbench tab or a .cpmproject / .bbmodel file), with their painting, colours, glow, effects and animations.
cpmplus.model.combine.tip: Tick the parts of the other model you want to bring. Each one comes with its painting (in free space of your texture), colours, glow, effects and animations. One Ctrl+Z undoes it all.
cpmplus.model.combine.where.auto: Each part on its own body part
cpmplus.model.combine.f.hd: Make the texture HD (like the other model's)
cpmplus.model.combine.f.hd.desc: The other model's painting has more pixels than your texture. In HD your skin stays the same and the painting keeps every detail. Without HD the painting is scaled down.
cpmplus.model.combine.empty: That model has no cubes to bring.
cpmplus.model.combine.nothing: Tick the parts you want to bring
cpmplus.model.combine.goes.one: Everything goes onto: %1. The parts stay where they are and move with that body part.
cpmplus.model.combine.goes.missing: The part "%1" does not exist in this model: goes onto %2.
cpmplus.model.combine.molang: %1 animation keys with a formula (Molang) are left out.
cpmplus.model.combine.meshes: %1 meshes are left out: only cubes come here (for meshes use Convert 3D model into parts).
cpmplus.model.combine.room.ok: The painting fits in the texture's free space.
cpmplus.model.combine.room.no: The painting does not fit in the texture's free space: when you combine, choose More texture space or Use colours only.
cpmplus.model.combine.room.notex: This model has no texture for that painting: the painted parts come as colour cubes.
cpmplus.model.combine.room.err: Could not check the space on the texture.
cpmplus.model.combine.noroom.ask: The parts' painting does not fit in the texture's free space. "More texture space" makes the texture area bigger (64 → 128) without touching what is already painted: the parts come with their whole painting. "Use colours only" brings each cube with its main colour, without using the texture.
cpmplus.model.combine.noroom.max: The painting did not fit even with a texture 8 times bigger. Bring fewer parts at once or use colours only.
cpmplus.model.combine.cpmonly: Combine another model works in a CPM project: open your CPM model and the other model in another tab (or choose its file).
cpmplus.model.combine.bad: Could not open that file. Choose a .cpmproject or .bbmodel model.
cpmplus.model.combine.moved: The project changed while the file was opening. Try again.
